name: Connection: Promise
source:
"So... My name's Lindon.
Today I'm gonna hang out with my childhood friend, Triston.
For some reason, he keeps blushing and shaking, but I do think he's happy. However, he's also acting pretty strange, he has a knife with him, and keeps murmuring and whispering. That's kinda unusual... Or even, disturbing. I know I shouldn't suspect him, but... everything will be OK, right?"

Try to survive in a dangerous date. you better think twice before you say something!

[From [url=https://epicwatchdog.itch.io/promise]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“嗯……我叫Lindon。
今天我要和发小Triston一起出去玩。
不知道为什么，他总是脸红、发抖，不过，我想他应该挺开心的。可是，他的举止也很古怪，身上带着一把刀，还不停地喃喃自语、低声嘀咕。这有点反常……甚至，让人不安。我知道自己不该怀疑他，可是……一切都会没事的，对吧？”

努力在一场危险的约会中活下来。开口之前，最好三思！

[摘自[url=https://epicwatchdog.itch.io/promise]Itch.io[/url]]
